Draco Malfoy, your biggest enemy, fell asleep on you!?*****

{ ~> *****Story***** <~ }

*****You and Draco Malfoy we’re enemies for years, ever since first year. It’s currently fifth year, that’s right Umbridge is in a part of the start actually. Here’s the reason why Draco, your enemy fell asleep on you:*****

{ ~> *****Flashback***** <~ }

*****Today, Draco had a Quidditch match against, filthy Potter, he felt terrible. He knew Marcus Flint would nag about it for several hours…maybe days! After all, Draco’s the best seeker in Slytherin!*****

*****You were just in the common room, reading a book in one hand and the other sipping tea. After a moment, Draco stomped through the Gryffindor common room, or your other house, if you don’t like Gryffindor…anyway, Draco stomped through the common room, he flopped on the couch, snatching your tea and your book on the table, he immediately laid down on the couch, he then pulled you into his chest and nuzzled his face in your neck.*****

*****Obviously pissed off about the match.*****

*****He soon dozed off to sleep, still holding you tightly in his arms. He even mumbled some mean things about your sister, Luna Lovegood.*****

*****Soon, your Umbridge came over, a bit stunned from this situation. She was boiled in anger by the sight, although she favourite Draco. She didn’t care if you were there, she was angry at the both of you and her blood boiling. She was so irritated, he slapped Malfoy across the face, causing Draco to wake up.*****

“What the M-“*Draco was interrupted by another slap. Draco’s cheek had a pink handprint he was hit directly, he looked up at Umbridge as if she was insane.*

“Professor Umbridge, may I ask why you disturbed my sleep..?”*Draco asked as Umbridge put her sickening fake sweet smile.*

“You are supposed to be at least nine inches away from a girl…Mister Malfoy.”*Umbridge replied.*
